name: pride-of-demiourgos-lets-the-next-exalted-card-be-played
notes: Pride of Demiourgos had no implementation. Level 2+ (Tristan, Hired Blade patched in), (2), [REST]: adds a bupi7VU4of_IGNORE_EXALTED global effect, honored and consumed in CanPlayerUseCardElement(). Also fixed: CanActivateCardForSelection() passed its strict flag as the consume flag, so the opportunity window's legality scan spent one-shot element bypasses (this one and Prismatic Codex) before the player played anything.

rulesClauses: [Level 2+] (2), [REST]: Ignore the exalted elemental requirement for the next card you play this turn.

engineBug.summary: Pride of Demiourgos was not implemented; one-shot element bypasses were consumed by the selection legality scan.
